subtitle: It's a lazy weekend, and Mr. A is casually watching a movie. In it, the protagonist, a girl who'd lived her whole life mistreated, one day receives a massive inheritance from someone. It turns out she was the long-lost granddaughter of a wealthy conglomerate family! From there, she uses the inheritance to repay those who'd been kind to her, and deliver a satisfying revenge on those who'd looked down on her. Mr. A, who found it fairly satisfying, soon remembers that this kind of thing could never happen in real life. We call this inheritance. As a concept, inheritance like this used to only be something you'd see in movies or dramas. It was practically a fictional concept, one you'd only find in a dictionary.
